title: EasyManager
description: EasyManager – All-in-one Minecraft server management plugin. Manage bans, kicks, restarts, whitelist, broadcasts, TPS, and more with simple commands.
body:
# 📜 EasyManager – All-in-One Server Management Plugin  

## 🔰 Introduction  
Are you tired of installing dozens of different plugins just to manage your Minecraft server?  
**EasyManager** is the all-in-one server management solution designed to give admins full control over their servers with **simple, clean, and powerful commands**.  

From banning players to restarting your server, from clearing lag to managing whitelist – everything is included.  
And the best part? Every command comes with built-in help (`/easyhtu`) so you’ll never forget how to use them!  

---

## ✨ Features  

### ✅ Player Management  
- `/easyban <player> [reason]` – Ban players with optional reason  
- `/easyunban <player>` – Unban players  
- `/easybanip <player> [reason]` – Ban player’s IP  
- `/easyunbanip <player>` – Unban IP  
- `/easybetterban <player> <reason> <serverName> <color> <expiry>` – Advanced ban with custom reason, server name, and expiry date  
- `/easykick <player> [reason]` – Kick a player with optional reason  

### ✅ Server Control  
- `/easystop` – Shut down the server safely  
- `/easyrestart` – Restart the server (runs console restart command)  
- `/easylockdown on/off` – Lock the server, blocking all new joins  
- `/easybroadcast <msg>` – Send announcements to all players  

### ✅ Whitelist Management  
- `/easywhitelist enable/disable` – Toggle whitelist  
- `/easywhitelist add/remove <player>` – Manage whitelist entries  
- `/easywhitelist list` – View whitelisted players  
- `/easywhitelist content <message>` – Custom kick message for non-whitelisted players  

### ✅ Server Utilities  
- `/easylist` – Show online players + ping  
- `/easyonline` – Show number of online players  
- `/easytps` – Display current TPS  
- `/easyclearlag` – Clear dropped items and unnecessary entities  

### ✅ Built-in Help System  
- `/easyhtu` – Displays **How To Use** for every command  
- Example: `/easyhtu easyban` → shows detailed usage, syntax, and examples  

---

## 🛠 Commands & Usage  

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/easyban <player> [reason]` | Ban a player with optional reason |
| `/easyunban <player>` | Remove player ban |
| `/easybanip <player> [reason]` | Ban by IP |
| `/easyunbanip <player>` | Unban IP |
| `/easybetterban <player> <reason> <serverName> <color> <expiry>` | Advanced ban with custom expiry |
| `/easykick <player> [reason]` | Kick a player |
| `/easybroadcast <message>` | Send announcement to everyone |
| `/easystop` | Stop the server |
| `/easyrestart` | Restart the server |
| `/easylockdown on/off` | Enable/disable lockdown mode |
| `/easywhitelist enable/disable` | Toggle whitelist |
| `/easywhitelist add/remove <player>` | Manage whitelist entries |
| `/easywhitelist list` | Show whitelisted players |
| `/easywhitelist content <message>` | Set custom whitelist kick message |
| `/easylist` | List online players with ping |
| `/easyonline` | Show number of online players |
| `/easytps` | Show server TPS |
| `/easyclearlag` | Remove dropped items/entities |
| `/easyhtu <command>` | Show detailed usage for a command |

---

## 🔐 Permissions  

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `easymanager.*` | Access to all EasyManager commands | OP |
| `easymanager.ban` | Use ban commands | OP |
| `easymanager.kick` | Use kick command | OP |
| `easymanager.broadcast` | Use broadcast command | OP |
| `easymanager.restart` | Restart/stop server | OP |
| `easymanager.clearlag` | Use clear lag | OP |
| `easymanager.whitelist` | Manage whitelist | OP |
| `easymanager.lockdown` | Use lockdown mode | OP |
| `easymanager.tps` | View TPS | OP |
| `easymanager.help` | Access to `/easyhtu` | true |

---

## ⚡ Installation  

1. Download the **EasyManager.jar**  
2. Place it into your `plugins/` folder  
3. Restart your server  
4. Done! 🎉  

No external dependencies required.  
Works on **Spigot / Paper / Bukkit**.  

---

## 🧭 Why EasyManager?  
- All-in-one management plugin → no need for 10+ plugins  
- Beginner friendly: every command has usage guide (`/easyhtu`)  
- Lightweight & optimized for performance  
- Great for small to medium servers  

---

## 🚀 Future Plans  
- GUI support for ban/kick/whitelist  
- Customizable messages in `config.yml`  
- Scheduled tasks (auto restart, auto clearlag)  
- MySQL/SQLite ban storage
